newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon guerrillas storm Israeli outpost.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon guerrillas storm Israeli outpost.

text.p: Hizbollah guerrillas attacked an Israeli outpost in south Lebanon on Monday, planting their flags on the position, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
The sources, which gave no immediate word on casualties, said the guerrillas attacked the outpost of Sojoud on the edge of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
In Beirut, a Hizbollah spokesman said preliminary information indicated the guerrillas "stormed into the outpost, killed Israeli soldiers and raised their flags outside it".
